chunks: And Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:
"Water should not be heated for the deceased."

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, Imam Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Bāqir عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: Should water be heated when washing the deceased in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the washing of the deceased, indicating that water is not to be heated for the dead body. It is part of the jurisprudential guidance transmitted from Imam Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Bāqir عليه السلام regarding funerary rites.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.394 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:
"Water should not be heated for washing the deceased."
